title: Witness burns as blue-shifted light from a warp bubble

tellings.quote: well, that sounds like visible band light being blue shifted into the ultraviolet and you're getting literally a sunburn.

plain: The burns some witnesses get near unexplained craft might come from a warp bubble, a proposed pocket of bent space around a craft that could let it move in unusual ways. The idea is that ordinary visible light is shifted up into ultraviolet, so people get "literally a sunburn." David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public about government UFO programs, offers this explanation, which would give a physical cause for injuries that witnesses report.
